setup.pencil: D(z):X_1->X_0, closed holomorphic Fredholm family on the constructed G4 domain
setup.right_global_section: Psi(z) with D(z)Psi(z)=0 and Psi(z) nonzero
setup.left_global_section: Lambda(z) in ker D(z)^dagger, supplied candidate-wise by the contragredient response branch

reduced_pencil.equivalent: D_red=Q_Y D Q_X between the projected bundles
reduced_pencil.meaning: remove the parameterwise Stokes right kernel and its contragredient left cokernel before spectral scalarization

grushin_operator.formula: G(z)=[[D(z),v(z)],[ell(z),0]]:X_1 direct-sum C -> X_0 direct-sum C
grushin_operator.equivalence: G(z) invertible iff D_red(z) invertible, provided the declared splittings and two-sided kernel relations hold
grushin_operator.advantage: fixed square Fredholm index and no quotient-bundle coordinate ambiguity

xi_candidate.determinant: E_red(z)=det_F G(z), or the corresponding determinant-line section
xi_candidate.required_identification: E_red(z)=c(z)Xi(z), with c holomorphic and nowhere zero
xi_candidate.kernel_correspondence: Xi(z)=0 iff D_red(z) has a nontrivial transverse kernel state
xi_candidate.multiplicity: order of E_red equals algebraic multiplicity of the transverse characteristic value under analytic Fredholm hypotheses

minimum_proof_obligations: D(z) is a holomorphic Fredholm family of fixed index zero in the declared rigging
Psi, Lambda, ell, and v are holomorphic and source-derived, with the two normalizations
the global Stokes right and left lines have constant rank one off the discrete transverse spectrum
G(z)-G(z_ref) is determinant class or admits a sourced regularized determinant
finite-shell Grushin determinants converge locally uniformly without spectral pollution
E_red/Xi extends holomorphically and is nowhere zero

noncircularity.allowed: choose ell and v by fixed source coordinates, e.g. the retained theta coordinate and its declared dual, before Xi specialization
noncircularity.forbidden: choose a complement, left section, or normalization by fitting Xi zeros
noncircularity.important: the canonical Stokes identity supplies only the removable global line; it does not establish the determinant identification

current_executable_frontier.first_test: verify that the retained theta coordinate ell(Psi)=1 and its contragredient dual define bounded holomorphic splittings on the completed domain
current_executable_frontier.second_test: compute the finite-shell Grushin Schur complement and test whether its zero set is nontrivial rather than identically zero
current_executable_frontier.third_test: compare that independently normalized finite-shell determinant with finite Euler/Xi sections before passage to completion

conclusion: The global Stokes kernel does not end the spectral route; it dictates a two-sided Grushin reduction. This is the minimal nontrivial determinant candidate. No Xi or RH implication is claimed until the reduced determinant identification and completion theorem are proved.
